errors.evidence: The description claims that for positions L₁ and R₁, the values for mBERT and XLM-R are 'around 15-20'. While approximately true for L₁, this is incorrect for R₁, where the values are much lower, around 10-11.
This statement incorrectly describes the relative values for category L₁. In L₁, the value for chLSTM (approx. 14) is not lower than mBERT (approx. 14) and is almost identical to XLM-R (approx. 15).
